lead.headline: Only 37 suppliers billed Medicare's diabetes-prevention classes for 11+ patients in 2024: 1,267 patients, $347,437 in all
lead.number: 37 suppliers, 1,267 patients, $347,437 (median supplier 22 patients) against 1,037 listed sites; at most about 3,800 patients even counting every hidden small supplier.
lead.watch_out: Low use is already reported; "existed before 2024" used the NPI issue date (40 of the 228 joined in 2024-26), the California line counts 64 Kaiser sites that joined in 2026, and Maryland's share is two suppliers, one mostly online.

sources.quote: Between April 2018 and March 2024, 9,015 Medicare beneficiaries have participated in the program.
sources.page_context: preventing type 2 diabetes Objective To prevent or delay the onset of type 2 diabetes in Medicare beneficiaries with prediabetes, thereby improving their health and reducing Medicare expenditures. Approach Examine weight loss, attendance, and diabetes onset among MDPP participants over time. Impact Between April 2018 and March 2024, 9,015 Medicare beneficiaries have participated in the program. MDPP beneficiaries attended an average of 18 sessions and were enrolled for approximately 8 months. On average, MDPP participants have lost 4.9% of their starting body weight, achieving a key short-term program goal.
